messages.subject: Schedule of Loss — draft for counsel
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Draft Schedule of Loss attached. Four heads tie to the pleaded total of £3,171,950: wasted manufacturing £1,284,500; replacement campaign £742,300; clinical standby/delay £958,400; investigation £186,750. Figures reconcile to Stephen's cost ledger and the supplier invoices. Harriet has flagged she may want to uplift the standby head once the extended delay period is confirmed.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
